cells.gaps: No source since October 2023 says refugees or displaced people may use SIM cards, mobile money or digital ID. Registration of new arrivals has been suspended since 2017.
cells.note: Stage 3: UNHCR counts 8,921 registered Kasai refugees in April 2026, every registered family holding identity documents. Nothing says refugees may use SIM cards, accounts or digital ID, so not 4.
